text_en: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，作于逃避其子阿贝沙隆时。

text_en: O Lord , how many are my foes! Many are rising against me;
text_cn: 上主，迫害我的人，不可胜数！ 攻击我的人，成群结队！

text_en: many are saying to me, “There is no help for you in God. ” Selah
text_cn: 很多人论及我说： “天主绝不拯救他！” (休止)

text_en: But you, O Lord , are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
text_cn: 但是你，上主，是围护我的盾牌， 是我的荣耀，常使我首昂头抬。

text_en: I cry aloud to the Lord , and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah
text_cn: 我一向上主大声呼号， 他便从圣山上俯听我。 （休止）

text_en: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the Lord sustains me.
text_cn: 我躺下安睡，我又醒了， 因为上主常扶持着我。

text_en: I am not afraid of ten thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around.
text_cn: 虽有千万人向我围攻， 我一丝一毫也不惊恐。

text_en: Rise up, O Lord ! Deliver me, O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the cheek; you break the teeth of the wicked.
text_cn: 上主，请你兴起奋发； 我的天主，求你救拔， 因为你击破了我仇敌的腮颊， 你打碎了众恶人的门牙。

text_en: Deliverance belongs to the Lord ; may your blessing be on your people! Selah
text_cn: 救援之恩完全属于上主； 愿你的百姓受你的祝福！ （休止）
